messages:
Marta (CS): Hey @Sam — quick weekly sync on Shoreline private deploy. Main check points: networking/egress, IAM cross-account role, KMS key access, and audit log delivery. Any blockers on your side or ETA for the KMS alias?
Sam (Customer): Thanks Marta — infra has opened most firewall rules. Still waiting on KMS alias creation (alias/rw-shoreline-priv) and the Redwood role ARN to attach. ETA today?
Ryan (NetEng): Pushed staging NAT fw rules. Egress allowed to 34.82.0.0/16 and 52.14.0.0/16 for model pulls. Also added route for 10.200.0.0/16 -> VGW. Can you confirm these are the ranges you opened?
Priya (Solutions): We need the role ARN in this form: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Priv-Shoreline. Sam, please attach this trust policy snippet to the role: ```{ "Version":"2012-10-17", "Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::917234567890:role/redwood-deploy"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}```
Sam (Customer): Copying infra team now. Will attach the trust policy. KMS team asked about rotation schedule — we prefer quarterly rotation.
Laura (Security): KMS alias/name OK but confirm key policy includes the deploy role + CloudTrail read permissions. Add tag key: "rotation":"quarterly". Audit logs must go to S3 with SSE-KMS and prefix "redwood-logs/shoreline-2026/". Also please ensure retention/policy is set before go-live.
Marta (CS): Great. Two remaining go/no-go items: 1) confirm CloudTrail delivery tested to the S3 prefix, 2) schedule a one-hour enablement session for app teams. Proposed Thu 15:00 UTC. Also flagging renewal risk: trial credits expire in 21 days — recommend we propose Dedicated reserved discount + 30-day committed capacity to keep latency predictable.
Priya (Solutions): Thu 15:00 UTC works. I'll cover prefix caching, batching, and quick cost controls to avoid token-cost spikes. Proposed agenda: 1) connectivity test (quick curl), 2) permissions walkthrough, 3) perf/cost tuning + Q&A.
Ryan (NetEng): Connectivity check example: `curl https://priv.redwood.example/connect -H 'X-Account: shore-123' --interface 10.200.1.5` — run from inside the private VPC. If you use a proxy, set HTTP_PROXY.
deploy-bot: CloudTrail delivery test -> 200 OK, object written to s3://redwood-logs/shoreline-2026/cloudtrail/2026-03-22/ (checksum OK).
Marta (CS): Thanks all. Sam, once infra confirms KMS alias + role attached I'll send the final go-live checklist and the renewal proposal. Quick poll: prefer a 1:1 pricing walkthrough or a joint session including your finance team? :bar_chart:
Sam (Customer): Joint session preferred. Small request: can Redwood also enable structured JSON access logs for model endpoints (for our SIEM ingestion)?
Priya (Solutions): Yes — we can enable structured access logs to the S3 bucket and include a sample schema in the enablement deck.
Laura (Security): Final ask — set the S3 bucket policy to block public access and enable MFA delete for retention-critical buckets. Also prefer lifecycle rules to move older audit objects to Glacier.
Marta (CS): Perfect — I'll collate action items and send an updated runbook + enablement invite after infra confirms. Action items: Ryan verify egress CIDRs, Sam confirm role attachment, Laura finalize KMS policy & retention tags, Priya prepare enablement deck. :thumbsup:
Sam (Customer): Will confirm today. Thanks everyone!
